aggregation.exploratory_full_denominator: For each model, add reviewed MATCH cases to the existing bounded normalized credited count and divide by all 384 planned QA responses. This is a post hoc AI estimate with a shared answer-level rubric, not an official primary score or independent risk certificate.
aggregation.no_credit: PARTIAL, MISMATCH, INVALID, and UNASSESSED receive zero added credit.
aggregation.positive_null_separation: Report positive-definition matches separately from null correctness; the overall denominator includes 192 positive and 192 null-gold requests per model.
aggregation.review_queue_counts: Report verdict counts over the 57 reviewed cases and over each model queue separately.

decisions.INVALID: The response is missing, malformed, or schema-invalid. A recovered or embedded null receives zero credit.
decisions.MATCH: All match requirements hold. Additional grounded sentences and wording changes can be accepted after reviewing the entire answer, never by substring containment alone.
decisions.MISMATCH: The answer selects a different candidate, retains a candidate collision, gives only an alias/metadata label, contradicts the gold meaning, or violates the registered-definition/null contract.
decisions.PARTIAL: The gold candidate or a relevant function/type is present, but the answer lacks a sufficient definition or clearly selects no referent. Partial answers receive zero binary semantic credit.
decisions.UNASSESSED: Evidence is insufficient to make any of the preceding decisions. This remains uncredited.

declaration_timing: Post hoc: the experiment and descriptive review already existed and the reviewer had seen the answers. This rubric is recorded separately before creating semantic verdict artifacts; it is not pre-registration.

evidence_policy.claim_checks: Record supported claims with verbatim frozen evidence, and record contradictory or unsupported claims separately. Entire answers, not only the expected-definition substring, must be inspected.
evidence_policy.grounding_inventory: Only the sealed original request knowledge_text/source_text and their frozen entity/definition pairs; no contemporary fixture, general world knowledge, or model-generated support.
evidence_policy.source_availability: Meaning against the gold is assessed separately from whether disambiguating source evidence was actually visible to the model. MATCH with source_gold_visible=false does not establish a justified resolution.

limitations: AI-authored, gold-visible, post hoc adjudication with two separate AI reviews lacks independent human annotation.
The original 32 AI-authored documents are a controlled synthetic sample, not independent deployment documents.
Only the 57 normalization-UNASSESSED answers are newly adjudicated; original definite matches/mismatches and positive abstentions keep their existing interpretation.
The rubric can be revised before a prospective experiment, but these post hoc choices must not be described as pre-registered.
required_for_match: The complete answer identifies only the gold registered referent, with no unresolved competing candidate.

It supplies a sufficient definition: the core operational function and the entity kind, explicitly or through a named entity kind such as team/center/committee. Registry name alone is PARTIAL even if the name is descriptive.
Every factual assertion added to the definition is supported by the frozen family knowledge document or frozen source document.
It does not negate the definition, assign it to another candidate, or conflate a core organization with a whole-surface person role, derived artifact, or NIL target.
scope: All 57 UNASSESSED answers from qa_definition_normalization_v1, gold-visible. This adjudication does not alter any original or normalized score.
title: Meaning-preserving registered definition answer, separate from verbatim format
